tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅// thugs rje chen po yid bzhin nor bu 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi phrin las bzhugs so//

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la: rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje chen po'i phrin las ni: phun sum tshogs pa bzhi ldan pa'i: sngon 'gro'i rim pa tshul bzhin bya: skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon song nas: dang po mtshams bcad pa ni: hrī: nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: 'dus pa'i lha rnams ma gtogs pa: bar gcod dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te mi 'gro 'dug gyur na: thugs rje chen po thugs khros nas: khro chen rta mgrin khros nas kyang: sprul pa yang sprul stong gsum gang: gdug pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams: bar chad thams cad rdul du rlog: oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha ha ya grī ba hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: nṛ tri sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: rang gi gnas de rta mgrin gyi: sprul pa mang pos gang bar bsam: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: bla ma 'phags pa 'khor bcas rnams: mdun gyi nam mkhar dmigs byas la: sgo gsum gus pas bshags pa 'bul: hrī: 'phags pa 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyis: sngon tshe 'khor ba thog med nas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i dbang gyur te: ngan song gsum gyi las bsags pa: lus ngag yid gsum sdig sgrib rnams: 'phags pa'i spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags: tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: pad+ma satwa ā: de nas byin dbab pa ni: spos dang rol mo thogs byas la: hrī: a la la hoḥ bha ga bān: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: hrī: chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs la: longs spyod rdzogs sku spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje sprul sku pad+ma 'byung: yang sprul thub drug sgo ma bzhi: 'gro drug sems can thugs rjes gzigs: dkyil 'khor 'di la byin phob la: bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyong du gsol: dkyil 'khor dbus su bzhugs su gsol: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta hūm̐:

de nas rang nyid khrus byas te: gtsang ma'i gos gyon me tog thogs: gtor ma mchod rdzas thams cad ni: bsang sbyang byin rlabs bya ba ni: oṃ swa bhā ba shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: thams cad stong par dag par sbyang: oṃ ā hā ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai bid+ya āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐: de nas bum pa sgrub pa ni: pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐: hrī: bum nang pad+ma'i gzhal yas khang: dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan: de steng hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: gu ru 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar: dang po'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar: phyag g.yas 'og ma shel phreng 'dzin: g.yon gyi 'og ma pad+ma bsnams: zhi ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab ma drug: de steng hūm̐ drug rang shar bas: shar du lha dbang brgya byin dkar: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis sgra snyan pi waṃ sgrog: lha la thugs brtse bzhengs te chas: shar lhor shākya seng ge ser: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis gseg shang par bu bsnams: mi la thugs brtse bzhengs te chas: lho nub nam mkha' mdzod dmar po: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis rin chen sgrom bu bsnams: yi dwags thugs brtse bzhengs te chas: nub tu seng ge dam ldan smug: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis glegs bam pusti bsnams: byol song thugs brtse bzhengs te chas: nub byang thags bzang ris sngon po: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis srung zlog go cha bsnams: lha min thugs brtse bzhengs te chas: byang shar chos kyi rgyal po mthing: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol:

phyag gnyis sgrib sbyong me chu bsnams: dmyal bar thugs brtse bzhengs te chas: sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas: dkar ser dmar ljang sgo ma bzhi: gtsang ma'i gos kyis mgul chings byas: dpag bsam sdong pos kha brgyan pa: byang chub sems kyi rdo rjes mtshan: thugs rje'i rgyun gyi gzungs thag btags: de nas dbyings kyi dbang bskur ba: hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa ltar: rigs kyi bdag pos dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas dbyings nas spyan drang ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: sras mchog rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung: sprul sku bcom ldan thub pa drug: ye shes lha mo sgo ma bzhi: 'gro drug sems can don mdzad phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lo ke shwa ra sa ma ya dza dza: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: rin chen bum pa'i gzhal yas su: gnyis med brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: 'gro drug sgrib sbyong phrin las mdzod: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: 'gro drug sdug bsngal sbyong mdzad pa'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thams cad la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: hrī: dri med yid 'ong gtsang mar sbyar ba yi: ar+ghaṃ me tog bdug spos mar me dang: dri chab zhal zas snyan pa'i rol mo 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs: 'dod yon drug gi mchod pa rgya chen 'bul: bzhes nas 'gro drug sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe ā hūm̐: la sogs bya/ ma hā sarba pū dza ho: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen pos 'gro drug kun la gzigs: byams dang snying rje sems can kun la snyoms: dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus skyed pa'i yab: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod:

rang byung lhun grub pad+ma 'byung gnas sku: skye 'chi gnyis spangs tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: snang srid lha srin thams cad dam la btags: rang byung sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: lha rnams 'dul phyir lha yi rgyal por sprul: nga rgyal dag pas 'dod yon longs spyod rol: ma chags zhen med chos la mnga' brnyes pa'i: lha yi thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: lha min 'dul phyir lha min rgyal por sprul: phrag dog dag pas 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal sbyong: zhe sdang mtshon dbal zhi la mnga' brnyes pa'i: lha min thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: mi rnams 'dul phyir mi yi rgyal por sprul: 'dod chags dag pas dka' thub nyon mongs sbyong: dam pa chos kyi gsung la mnga' brnyes pa'i: mi yi thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: byol song 'dul phyir byol song rgyal por sprul: gti mug dag pas shes rab ye shes gsal: ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron me bsnams: byol song thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: yi dwags 'dul phyir yi dwags rgyal por sprul: ser sna dag pas dgos 'dod re ba skong: 'dod yon mi zad longs spyod mnga' brnyes pa'i: yi dwags thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: dmyal ba 'dul phyir dmyal ba'i rgyal por sprul: zhe sdang dag pas snying rje'i thabs kyis 'dren: srid pa las kyi me long chos ston mdzad: dmyal ba'i thub pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi'i gzhal yas su: dkar ser dmar ljang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad: ye shes sgo ma bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: lha rnams dgyes pa'i rang sgra las: 'gro drug sgrib sbyong gzungs 'di shar: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐ hrī: ting 'dzin gsal bas snying po bzla: bum pa ye shes bdud rtsis gang: lha gshegs bum chus khrus bya 'o: ྈྈ ྈྈ de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni:

hrī: chos sku nam mkha' lta bu la: thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don la dgongs: rang byung rang rig rang shar sku: 'byung ba lnga 'dus 'jig rten 'di: rang gsal chags med gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan dang ldan: 'dod yon pha gu drwa ba dang: drwa phyed mda' yab rta babs rgyan: chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs dang bcas: twa ra ṇa yis rab tu brgyan: phyi rol rdo rje me ris bskor: rin chen gzhal yas gsal bar bsgom: dkyil 'khor dbus kyi lte ba la: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: hrīḥlas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi sku mdog dkar: dang po'i phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar: phyag g.yas 'og ma shel phreng 'dzin: g.yon gyi 'og ma pad+ma bsnams: zhi ba'i rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan: zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab drug la: de steng hūm̐ drug rang shar bas: shar du lha dbang brgya byin dkar: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis sgra snyan pi waṃ sgrog: lha la thugs brtse bzhengs nas chas: shar lhor shākya seng ge ser: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis gseg shang par bu bsnams: mi la thugs brtse bzhengs nas chas: lho nub nam mkha' mdzod dmar po: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis rin chen sgrom bu 'dzin: yi dwags thugs brtse bzhengs nas chas: nub tu seng ge dam ldan smug: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis glegs bam pusti bsnams: byol song thugs brtse bzhengs nas chas: nub byang thag bzang ris sngon po: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis srung zlog go cha bsnams: lha min thugs brtse bzhengs nas chas: byang shar chos kyi rgyal po mthing: sprul sku'i cha byad chos gos gsol: phyag gnyis sgrib sbyong me chu bsnams: dmyal bar thugs brtse bzhengs nas chas: sgo bzhir dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥlas: shar sgor dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin:

lho sgor ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: nub sgor dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: byang sgor ljang mo dril bu 'dzin: g.yon pa thams cad shel phreng 'dzin: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes: phyi rol 'khor yug chen po la: gtsang ris dpal mgon srung mar bcas: bsam gyis mi khyab sprin ltar 'thibs: bstan pa srung ba'i phrin las mdzad: de nas dbyings kyi dbang bskur ba ni: hrī: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs pa ltar: rigs kyi bdag pos dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs su lhun gyis grub: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: a bhi ṣiñca ā: de nas spos dang rol mo thogs: rtse gcig gdung bas spyan drang ba ni: hrī: sngon tshe bskal pa thog ma la: 'gro drug sdug bsngal thugs rjes gzigs: smon lam stobs kyis 'gro don mdzad: byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs: gnas mchog 'di ru gshegs su gsol: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od lnga rgya mtsho'i klong du spros: rgyu med rkyen med sprul pa'i sku: pad+ma las 'khrungs ngo mtshar can: pad+ma 'byung gnas gshegs su gsol: khyed kyis 'gro drug don mdzad phyir: gang la gang 'dul thabs kyis sprul: rgyun chad med par 'gro don mdzad: bde gshegs sprul sku thub pa drug: thugs dam rgyud bskul gnas 'dir gshegs: sems can 'dzin pas bcings pa yi: lam gyi bar chad bsal ba'i phyir: 'gugs 'dren 'ching sdom dgyes mdzad ma: sgo srung lha mo chen mo bzhi: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: lo ke shwa ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: 'gro drug sdug bsngal sbyong ba dang: bdag gi bsam pa rdzogs bya'i phyir: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sa ma ya ā be sha ya a tiṣ+ṭha lhan: de nas brda' phyag 'tshal ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs:

'gro ba sgrol mdzad stobs chen lha: sprul pa'i sku ru rang byung ba: pad+ma 'byung gnas thugs kyi sras: gang la gang 'dul thub pa drug: tshad med lha mo sgo ma bzhi: rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad la: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hrī: dri med yid 'ong gtsang sbyar ba'i: gtsang ma'i ar+ghaṃ mchod pa 'bul: tsan+dan la sogs spos sbyar ba'i: dri zhim ngad ldan mchod pa 'bul: pad+ma ut+pal mdangs ldan pa'i: gsal 'tsher me tog mchod pa 'bul: nyi zla'i snying po mun sel ba'i: snang gsal sgron me mchod par 'bul: chu bo rnyog med bsil ba yi: gtsang ma'i dri chab mchod pa 'bul: 'bru bcud snying po kun bsdus pa'i: dkar gsum mngar gsum rgyan gyis mdzes: gtor ma lha yi zhal zas 'bul: dung dang sil snyan rnga chen sgra: pi waṃ pheg rdob gling bu'i sgra: snyan pa'i rol mo sna tshogs 'bul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ ā ha ra ā ha ra sarba bid+yā dha ra pū tsi te āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai bid+ya āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ba liṃ ta āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: hrī: rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan cod pan phreng ba dang: do shal dpung rgyan rin chen se mo do: dar gyi stod g.yogs smad dkris sham bur ldan: phyag gdub zhabs gdub rin chen du mas spras: 'dod yon ma spangs rang grol rgyan du bzhes: rat+na sarba pū tsa hūm̐: hrī: kun bzang kun khyab bla bre gur chen po: skyabs mchog gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can: snying po mi nub rtags kyi rgyal mtshan dang: 'gro drug snying rjes skyob pa'i 'phan phreng dang: shes skyob dar gur yol ba sum rim dang: pho brang bkra shis yongs rdzogs mchod par 'bul: hrī: log rtog gcod pa'i shes rab ral gri dang:

shes rab thabs ldan ma rig 'big pa'i mda': sgrib med sku gsum yongs rdzogs dar tshon 'phur: ma rig bag chags kun 'khrud khrus bum dang: rig pa snying rje thabs kyi gzungs thag dang: ye shes lnga ldan tshon skud drwa ba dang: bdud bzhi tshar gcod ye shes phur pas 'bigs: dkyil 'khor rgyan rnams yongs rdzogs mchod par 'bul: hrī: chos sku mi 'gyur thabs kyi rdo rje dang: chos dbyings klong yangs shes rab dril bu dang: chos sgras stong gsum khyab byed rnga bo che: tshangs pa'i gsung ldan pi waṃ chos sgra sgrog: dngos bshams yid sprul mchod rdzas yongs rdzogs 'bul: hrī: 'khor lo rin chen chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: nor bu rin chen dgos 'dod thams cad skong: btsun mo rin chen pha rol phyin bcu ldan: khyim bdag rin chen chab srid rab tu spel: glang po rin chen bdud kyi dpung tshogs bcom: rta mchog rin chen 'khor ba'i pha rol sgrol: dmag dpon rin chen nyon mongs g.yul ngo zlog: rin chen sna bdun yongs rdzogs mchod pa 'bul: hrī: sgrub rdzas yungs dkar rgyal pos bgegs tshogs 'joms: rdzas mchog bil bas yon tan thams cad rgyas: rtswa mchog dūrbas gnod pa thams cad skyob: li khri mtshal chen 'gro ba dbang du sdud: gi waṃ sman gyis nyon mongs nad kun sel: bcud ldan zho yis dbang po'i gzi mdangs skyed: gsal byed me long ma rig mun pa sel: chos dung g.yas 'khyil gsung dbyangs drug cur sgrog: bkra shis rdzas brgyad yongs rdzogs mchod pa 'bul: hrī: gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo me long 'dzin: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs spyan la 'bul: sgra yi lha mo sngon mo pi waṃ 'dzin: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs snyan la 'bul: dri yi lha mo ser mo spos khang 'dzin: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs shangs la 'bul: ro yi lha mo dmar mo zhal zas 'dzin: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs ljags la 'bul:

reg bya'i lha mo ljang gu na bza' 'dzin: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs sku la 'bul: chos kyi lha mo mthing ga pusti bsnams: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs thugs la 'bul: 'dod yon drug gi mchod pa rgya chen 'bul: phyi nang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mnyes gyur cig: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hrī: dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas: smon lam stobs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa: mthong thos dran pas sdug bsngal kun las grol: 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nyid thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas: rgyu med rkyen med rgya mtsho'i klong las 'khrungs: rgyal ba'i sras mchog rang byung sprul pa'i sku: pad+ma 'byung gnas sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: khyed kyi thugs rjes 'gro drug sdug bsngal gzigs: thabs mkhas thugs rjes ngan song sbyong ba'i phyir: gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku ru bstan: bcom ldan thub pa drug la phyag 'tshal bstod: byams dang snying rje dga' dang btang snyoms kyi: tshad med bzhi yis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i: sems can las dang mthun pa'i lam sna 'dren: sgo skyong lha mo bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka'i snying po las: 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing du thim: bde gshegs thugs kyi bcud bsdus yi ger byon: nam mkha'i 'brug ltar sgrog pa'i yi ge drug: snying po yi ge drug la phyag 'tshal bstod: snying po 'di nyid mthong thos reg pa yis: sems can thams cad ngan song gnas las thar: thugs rje chen po thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa'i: gsung mchog yi ge drug la phyag 'tshal bstod: thugs rje phyogs ris med pa kun la snyoms: rang rig ma bcos rang grol chen por shar: gang yang ma spangs 'dzin med bde ba che: thugs kyi dgongs pa mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod: de ltar cho ga rnam dag gis: mchod pa 'bul zhing bsnyen pa bya: rab kyis zla gcig 'bum phrag drug: 'bring gis zhag bdun 'bum dang khri tsho bzhi: tha mas zhag gcig khri phrag gcig: tshes bcu'i nyin par ci nus bzla: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: 'di nyid ci nus bzlas par bya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥ.oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐: oṃ ni sangs rgyas kun gyi sku:

āḥni sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung: hūm̐ ni sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs: hrīḥni bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku: oṃ ni ye shes lnga dang ldan: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: ma ni thugs rje chen po'i sku: 'gro drug sems can sdug bsngal sbyong: ṇi ni zhi bas sdig sgrib sbyong: pad kyis yon tan rgyas par spel: me ni dbang gis kun la sgyur: hūm̐ gis drag pos bgegs rnams 'joms: phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad: dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: de nas rtags bstod bya ba ni: hrī: thugs rje chen po spyan ras gzigs: sku mdog dkar po 'od zer 'phro: nyon mongs skyon gyis ma gos rtags: zhal gcig 'dzum pa'i tshul ston pa: sems can kun la byams pa'i rtags: spyan gnyis zhi bas gzigs pa ni: thugs rje kun la snyoms pa'i rtags: phyag gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar: thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba'i rtags: g.yas kyi 'og mas shel phreng bsnams: 'khor ba'i gnas nas 'dren pa'i rtags: g.yon gyi 'og mas pad+ma bsnams: chags med skyon gyis ma gos rtags: zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i skyil krung bzhugs: mnyam nyid don las ma g.yos rtags: pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ni: chags med 'gro don mdzad pa'i rtags: rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan pa ni: 'dod yon ma spang rang dag rtags: 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba ni: 'gro drug sgrib pa sbyong ba'i rtags: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbu brgyan pa: pad+ma'i rigs las 'khrungs pa'i rtags: sprul sku thub drug 'gro don mdzad: 'gro drug skye sgo gcod pa'i rtags: lha mo bzhi yis sgo srung mdzad: phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa'i rtags: spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas zhal zas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni: tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor bsham: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis bsregs sbyangs te: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: de nas tshogs la spyan drang ba ni:
